description: Source code for the MarkAttendanceScreen widget in a Flutter app, used for demo purposes to mark student attendance quickly.

classes.name: MarkAttendanceScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays UI to mark student attendance, allowing input of student name, period, and attendance status. It provides a button to save the attendance status asynchronously.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _MarkAttendanceScreenState.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous save operation to mark attendance via the AttendanceProvider, updating local state to show feedback.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of TextEditingControllers when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the screen, displaying input fields, a switch for attendance, and a save button, while managing snack bar notifications.
